item.name: captcha
item.description:
Requests that need a person: the captcha text is only in the SVG image, so CI never runs this folder
(`newman run … --folder api`). Walk it by hand in Postman against a running server:

1. Run `api` → `auth` → `registration` once (it sets `email`), or set `email` to an existing user.
2. Run `login (wrong password)` five times: the 1st–4th answer 401 with `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` and
   `resultCode` 1, the 5th adds `NEED_AUTHORIZATION_WITH_CAPTCHA` with `resultCode` 10.
3. Run `login (wrong captcha)`: 401, `resultCode` 10, the only error `NEED_AUTHORIZATION_WITH_CAPTCHA`.
4. Run `get captcha URL`, open `data.captchaURL` in a browser, type the text into the `captcha_text` variable.
5. Run `login (with captcha)`: 201 — the counter is reset, the next failed login is plain again.

Postman keeps the session cookie between the requests; the counter lives in that session.
